name: Azerbaijan

flag.description: Three equal horizontal stripes of blue, red and green, with a white crescent and white eight-pointed star in the centre of the red stripe.
flag.symbolism: Blue represents Turkic heritage, red progress and modernisation, and green Islam; the eight points of the star are often linked to the eight branches of the Turkic peoples.

hook: Azerbaijan is blue-red-green with the crescent and eight-pointed star centred in the red stripe; Uzbekistan has a white middle band and its crescent in the blue corner.
trivia: The flag was first adopted in 1918 by the Azerbaijan Democratic Republic and restored in 1991.
Baku lies about 28 metres below sea level, making it the lowest-lying national capital in the world.
